summary: Track 14.0-PM-STAFFING-UI-DISCOVERABILITY-CLOSURE — backend contract suite (11/11) + new e2e suite (9/10) + frontend smoke across all 10 discoverability locations. Admin surfaces verified end-to-end. Two regressions discovered: (1) backend _is_pm_on_project() data-source mismatch with /api/project-staffing/summary causing PM 403s on their own team, (2) PM Project Detail route /pm/project/{pn} returns 404 (route only exists at /pm/projects-legacy/{pn} per App.js).

critical.issue: PM (cert.pm@example.com) gets 403 'PM not assigned to this project' on ZZ-RUNTIME-CERT-2026 even though /api/project-staffing/summary returns this project to them. Root cause: _is_pm_on_project() in /app/backend/routes/project_team_assignments.py (line 155) consults ONLY jobs_master.pm_email (which is jaymn.judd@mascigc.com) and ignores project_team_assignments rows where cert.pm has assignment_role='pm'. The staffing summary uses project_team_assignments, hence the mismatch. The frontend PM team page renders the amber red error 'team-fetch: 403' as a result.

ui_bugs.issue: Returns 404 — route is not registered in /app/frontend/src/App.js. The expected PmProjectDetail page is only mounted at /pm/projects-legacy/:projectNumber (line 727). The inline JobTeamRosterPanel + pm-project-team-full-page-link testids only render via the legacy route. Review request URL /pm/project/ZZ-RUNTIME-CERT-2026 does not resolve.

ui_bugs.component: JobTeamRosterPanel add-form role select (admin team page)
ui_bugs.issue: The role select trigger is a shadcn-style custom Button (tag=BUTTON, not native <select>). Clicking it did not open a listbox during automated test — querySelectorAll('[role="option"]') returned 0. Cannot programmatically verify the 17 options + 'admin-only' badges + PM-disabled tooltip text 'Admin only — request from your administrator' through black-box automation. Suggest adding role="option" + data-testid="job-team-role-option-{role_id}" + data-disabled-pm attributes on each menu item to make the discoverability/permission UX testable.

integration_issues.issue: Panel renders + amber PM-scope note renders correctly, but team list shows red banner 'team-fetch: 403' and '0 active' — cert.pm cannot read or write their own roster (see backend critical bug). All UX/discoverability is correct; the runtime is non-functional for the cert PM.

Could not verify hremp-project-assignments section: page returns '403 You don't have access to HR Portal' even with admin token in localStorage. Needs separate masci.hr.token from multi-login portal_tokens.hr. Code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/HrEmployees.jsx (line ~720) confirms data-testid='hremp-project-assignments' is wired, but black-box validation in HR portal scope was blocked.

action_items: BACKEND-CRITICAL: Update _is_pm_on_project() in /app/backend/routes/project_team_assignments.py (line 155) to also accept PMs declared via project_team_assignments (assignment_role='pm', active=True). Without this fix, cert.pm — the documented PM cert user — cannot read or manage the ZZ-RUNTIME-CERT-2026 roster, defeating the entire PM-staffing discoverability closure.

FRONTEND: Add a Route at /pm/project/:projectNumber → PmProjectDetail in /app/frontend/src/App.js (currently only /pm/projects-legacy/:projectNumber exists). Review explicitly states the URL /pm/project/{pn} is the canonical inline-team-section page.

FRONTEND TESTABILITY: In JobTeamRosterPanel role select, attach data-testid='job-team-role-option-{role_id}' (and role='option') to each option, and a data-admin-only='1' attribute on the three admin-only items. This makes the 'admin-only badge but enabled for admin' and 'disabled with tooltip for PM' contracts directly assertable.
DATA SEED: Re-seed jobs_master.pm_email='cert.pm@example.com' on ZZ-RUNTIME-CERT-2026 (or remove duplicate jaymn.judd assignment) so the cert-PM contract holds even before the _is_pm_on_project fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Two systems of record for 'who is the PM of a project': jobs_master.pm_email (single string) vs project_team_assignments where assignment_role='pm' (can be multiple). The new staffing summary uses the latter, the existing permission gate uses the former — these MUST be reconciled or _is_pm_on_project will keep blocking legitimate PMs.
/app/backend/routes/project_team_assignments.py is now ~1026 lines — beyond the 700-line guideline. Split into permissions.py + admin_router.py + pm_router.py + summary.py for maintainability.

Admin endpoint POST /api/admin/jobs/{pn}/team rejects PM tokens with require_admin_dep, which is correct — the review's wording 'POST /api/admin/jobs/{pn}/team as PM token returns 403' is satisfied by 401 'Invalid admin token'. Role-level boundary is actually enforced on /api/pm/job/{pn}/team via _can_manage_project_team — and that boundary works perfectly (verified: pm/co_pm/executive_oversight all return 403 with reason 'role is admin-only').
Discoverability tiles, table, manage-links, amber Team button, PM scope amber note, and 17-role roster copy are all wired correctly with the documented testids. UI scaffolding is solid.

rca_of_the_issue: PRIMARY BUG: PM permission check uses a different source-of-truth than PM scoping. Repro: (1) login as cert.pm via multi-login; (2) GET /api/project-staffing/summary → ZZ-RUNTIME-CERT-2026 returned in projects; (3) GET /api/pm/job/ZZ-RUNTIME-CERT-2026/team → 403 'PM not assigned to this project'. Mitigation: extend _is_pm_on_project (line 155 in project_team_assignments.py) to also query db.project_team_assignments for assignment_role='pm' AND email=actor.email AND active=true, OR back-fill jobs_master.pm_email from primary PM assignment during write. SECONDARY BUG: Route /pm/project/:projectNumber missing — App.js only registers /pm/projects-legacy/:projectNumber for PmProjectDetail.
